name: Maid-san to Tsunagaritai
original_name: メイドさんと繋がりたい
source:
The protagonist (an anime otaku), is taken to a maid café by his friend Yamamoto. At first, the protagonist isn't very interested, but he falls in love at first sight with the maid "Ichigo-chan" whom he meets at the store, and from thereforth becomes a frequent customer visiting every week.

However, the maid café has a rule: "Exchanging contact information with customers is prohibited" which makes it difficult to break out of the customer-staff relationship.

Visit the café every week to become friends with "Ichigo-chan" and aim for a happy ending!

[Translated from NovelGame]
translation:
主角（动漫御宅族）被朋友山本带到女仆咖啡厅。主角一开始并不太感兴趣，但他对在店里遇到的女仆“一护酱”一见钟情，从此成为每周都会光顾的常客。

然而，女仆咖啡厅有一条规定：“禁止与顾客交换联系方式”，这使得顾客与员工的关系很难脱离。

每周都去咖啡馆与“一护酱”成为朋友，争取幸福的结局！

[译自小说游戏]
